title: Lohe Ke Haath
desc: Gayatri's mother-in-law Bindu Devi tries to set fire to her on her wedding night for her dowry; her husband Jainath is equally responsible for this attempt. Gayatri is saved by Triloki, but he doesn't have good intentions: he rapes her. Gayatri saves another woman from getting molested and both meet Maataji, who is also a victim of dowry. Maataji trains helpless women to fight against injustice and Gayatri turns into a rebel.

title: Tawaif
desc: Due to unforeseen circumstances, Dawood accepts Sultana, a courtesan, as his wife in spite of being in love with author Kaynat. His life soon changes when he finds himself falling for Sultana.

title: Doodh Ka Karz
desc: A snake charmer is falsely accused of theft by the landlords and beaten to death. His wife, Parvati, raises her son, Suraj, who, along with the loyal snake, sets out to avenge his father's death.

title: Kasak
desc: Divya, a young woman, loves Suraj, who dies an unfortunate and untimely death. She is soon forced to marry Vijay due to familial pressure but not long after demands that he divorce her.
